contentFit.register: Mid-register §11 clarity, §13 conciseness. Why-before-how §11.8.
Formal register, Bloom verbs per tier §16.
Mid-register, contractions permitted, second-person address §15.1.
Bridge to next topic. Never restates LOs verbatim.
Text only, no content-level visual. VO-1 treatment 5: a deliberate choice, not a fallback, where the theme's background imagery and prose carry the page without competing for visual space.
Step-by-step reveal; each item is one step. §15.4 instruction register.
Self-contained first sentence, no contractions. Glossary-style.

entries.name: mcq

contentFit.register: Formative check. Feedback confirms and gives the reason (§15.5); never bare Correct/Wrong. Final-attempt feedback follows the four-move shape (AUD-AWM-SUMM-2).
Assessment context. No per-item feedback during attempt when _suppressMarking=true.

configNotes: _attempts: formative mcq = option count minus 1 (D4 ruling, 13 Sep 2026, supersedes the previous flat '2 for formative'); -1 for summative (unlimited, remediation-first) unchanged
_isRandom: true shuffles options; verified harmless for single-correct MCQs
Summative: _canShowFeedback/Marking: true but _suppressMarking: true on article delays until all answered

Completion on submission of the final attempt, not on correctness, is the framework default (questionModel.js checkQuestionCompletion: _isCorrect || _attemptsLeft === 0), not a behaviour change introduced by D4

_canShowModelAnswer is button-gated (questionModel.js getButtonState -> BUTTON_STATE.SHOW_CORRECT_ANSWER) and is NOT the mechanism for revealing the correct answer on the final attempt; the reveal is authored into the final-attempt feedback text (_incorrectFinal / _feedback._incorrect.final), which fires automatically at _attemptsLeft === 0

entries.name: sortable

contentFit.register: Sequence or rank items. Instruction field §15.4.
Assessment context; same config pattern as mcq.

configNotes: _isRandom: true shuffles initial order; learner drags to correct sequence
Pilot verified: 2 sortables in SUMM-a-01 work alongside 6 MCQs

entries.name: textinput

contentFit.register: No right answer framing §15.3. 1-3 genuine metacognition questions.

configNotes: _isOptional: true — never blocks completion
_questionWeight: 0, _canShowFeedback/Marking/ModelAnswer: false
_recordInteraction: true for SCORM tracking
PENDING MIGRATION: opentext.md §11 plans replacement with adapt-abbott-opentext

entries.name: confidence

contentFit.register: PRE: rate against outcomes just seen. POST: five-pattern comparison feedback WR-2d.

configNotes: _mode: pre or post
_selfAssessmentGroupId pairs PRE and POST across C-PRE/C-POST pages
Max 10 items per WR-2a
_itemFeedbackOverrides for per-item five-pattern feedback (rose, stayedHigh, dropped, stayedLow, noMovement)

entries.name: assessmentResults

contentFit.register: Band feedback per S-3. No contractions #15 (summative feedback).

configNotes: _assessmentId must match the assessment article ID
Band thresholds: 70% pass per S-3
_retry.button for retry action when enabled

entries.name: references

contentFit.register: Links open in new tab. Instruction field mid-register.

configNotes: _items[].type: book | article | external
Links must use target=_blank (not within SCORM package)
Per PLR-1: variable/optional per-pathway, same design-palette logic as VO-1

entries.name: hotgraphic

contentFit.register: Spatial overview with whole-shape-at-once visibility. VO-1 treatment 1. Modes: cyclical, sequential, or any arrangement where the base image carries the structure. Higher cost than timeline (requires authored graphic); use when spatial arrangement is worth the image production.
Interactive diagram with click-to-reveal regions.

configNotes: _graphic.src: base image; _items[]: hotspot definitions
_isNarrativeOnMobile: true provides mobile fallback as narrative
Pilot uses for writing-cycle diagram in W-OPEN signpost

entries.name: narrative

contentFit.register: Staged processes with per-stage visual identity. VO-1 treatment 2.
Image-per-item slideshow; each step pairs image with text.

configNotes: _items[]: each with title, body, strapline, _graphic
_setCompletionOn: allItems (must view each slide)
No authored lesson instance exists yet in pilot — spec is illustrative
A real image in _graphic.src is required for every item; never proposed with a placeholder (RT-1)

entries.name: timeline

contentFit.register: Linear/staged processes, non-cyclical. VO-1 treatment 3. §15.4 instruction, §11 clarity for stage titles, §4 why-explaining for body.

entries.accessibility: <ol>/<li> per stage; native button with aria-expanded, aria-controls to detail region.
configNotes: Stage count 3–8 (fewer rarely justifies; more loses overview value)
_expandBehaviour: 'single' (default, deliberate) vs 'independent'; single keeps overview scannable
No _id per item — index-keyed; reordering _items between sessions breaks restoration (same hazard as flipcard)

entries.name: resultsdebrief

contentFit.register: Consolidated study-plan injection post-assessment. Lesson-group remediation pointers.

configNotes: _assessmentId (singular) — config inconsistency with passreveal's _assessmentIds[] noted in doc-audit F7 standing note
_resultsDebrief._items[]: lesson groups with titles and remediation text
Injects after assessment complete; verified 14 Aug (debrief injection count === 1)

specPointer.note: F1: no resultsdebrief.md spec exists; cite passreveal.md + backlog 14 Aug records

entries.name: passreveal

contentFit.register: Model-answer gating. Hidden until pass; revealed after to support reflection.

configNotes: _assessmentIds[] (array) — config inconsistency with resultsdebrief's _assessmentId noted
Guard chain: extension enabled → assessment ID match → isPass true
Sets _canShowModelAnswer: true on pass; idempotent

entries.name: annotated

contentFit.register: Weak/strong writing pairs with phrase-level commentary. §15.2 evaluative about work not person; §4 explain why; §13 mid-register.
Teaching prose where specific phrases warrant explanation without breaking flow. §13 mid-register; §4 explain why in _note.body.

configNotes: _passage[]: array of segments; segments with _note are annotated, others are plain prose
Single-open by default: opening a new note closes any open one
Completion = all annotated segments visited

entries.name: branching

contentFit.register: Professional dilemma with plausible choices; consequence prose is instructive not punitive. §13 teaching prose, §4 explain why, §15.4 instruction.

configNotes: _selectionBehaviour: commit (default, one choice locks) or explore (compare all)
No correct answer — every choice is plausible (BR-6)
Completion fires on first selection, not all-visited
Index-keyed persistence: reordering _items breaks restore

entries.name: checklist

contentFit.register: Concrete yes/no actions the learner ticks through. §15.4 instruction register. CL-7: every item concrete, no evaluative items.
Reusable review list the learner returns to before submitting work. §15.4 instruction register; ticks reset on revisit (CL-2) so it stays fresh per task.

configNotes: 4–8 items enforced by schema
Ticks do NOT persist (CL-2): reset on revisit, completion persists
No summary/scoring/feedback — working aid, not assessment (CL-6)

STATUS: built-unused, but routable — activity-patterns/action-checklist (added 2 Sep 2026, commit bfa51d3) names this component in its realisations; no course has adopted it yet (5.92, ruled 8 Sep 2026: keep). Correction, 14 Sep 2026: this note previously read 'no activity-patterns entry lists it in realisations, so it is not routable', which was wrong when written on 8 Sep 2026 (commit 5eea913) — the action-checklist pattern already existed six days earlier and is unchanged since. Not superseded; the earlier claim never checked the store it was describing.

entries.name: flipcard

contentFit.register: Term or concept on front, explanation on back. §11 clarity for front; §4 why-explaining for back; tier-appropriate depth §16.
VO-1 treatment 4: playful/interactive reveal for 3–6 items.

configNotes: _flipBehaviour: independent (default) or single (one card open at a time)
3–6 cards per instance; larger sets lose flip affordance value
Index-keyed persistence: reordering _items breaks restore (FC-1)

entries.name: glossary

contentFit.register: Definition at point of need in teaching prose. §15.7: first sentence self-contained, no contractions in definitions. 2–8 terms per passage.

configNotes: _passage[]: segments with _term carry definitions; mark first use only
Three-way routing: glossary (passage) vs accordion (standalone) vs parenthetical (text)
Single-open by default; completion = all terms visited

entries.name: opentext

contentFit.register: No right answer framing §15.3. Learner-authored writing that persists. Replaces textinput for reflections.
Working notes variant. Never completion-bearing.

configNotes: _variant: reflection (default, optionally completion-bearing) or notes (never completion-bearing)
_maxCharacters: 4000 default (suspend_data budget constraint RTR-1e)
Autosave on blur and debounced typing; no submit gesture required
Extends ComponentModel not QuestionModel — no marking, no interactions record

entries.name: tabs

contentFit.register: 2–4 parallel chunks with random access. §13 teaching prose, §11 clarity for tab labels. Tabs imply unordered; use timeline if order matters.

configNotes: 2–4 tabs enforced by schema; concise tab labels (1–3 words)
First tab selected on load counts as visited
Completion = all tabs visited; index-keyed persistence

entries.name: matching

contentFit.register: Pairing prompts to answers from a per-row option set: terms to definitions, examples to categories, causes to effects (§1). Feedback follows the shared two-tier pattern with a _partlyCorrect branch authored, since partial credit is common (§3 guardrail 4).
Assessment context; formative/summative bundle set as a unit (§3 guardrail 5), same discipline as mcq/sortable.

entries.accessibility: Native <select> dropdowns per row; ariaQuestion populated when body carries HTML or scene-setting so the screen reader announces a clean question (§6).
configNotes: Each row has its own _options array; options need not be identical across rows (§3 guardrail 1)
Exactly one _isCorrect: true per row (§3 guardrail 2)
_allowOnlyUniqueAnswers: false by default; set true when each option should be used once (§3 guardrail 3, §7)
No authored lesson instance exists yet; c-225 is Adapt demo scaffold content, not a voice model (Grounded in note)

entries.name: gmcq

contentFit.register: Visual discrimination task: diagrams, charts, or patterns that cannot be adequately distinguished by text alone (§1). Shares mcq's question mechanics (feedback, attempts, scoring, _selectable); the structural difference is that _items carry _graphic objects.
Assessment context; formative/summative bundle set as a unit, same discipline as mcq (§3 guardrail 4).

entries.accessibility: alt text on every option image is mandatory so screen-reader users can discriminate between options; generic alt like 'Option 1' defeats the component's purpose (§6).
configNotes: _shouldBeSelected count must match intent: single-select exactly one true; multi-select set _selectable to the number of correct options (§3 guardrail 1)
Per-item feedback is single-select only; ignored on multi-select (§3 guardrail 5)
_columns defaults to 0 (component decides); set explicitly for consistent layout (§7)
No authored lesson instance exists yet; c-210 is Adapt demo scaffold content, not a voice model (Grounded in note)

entries.name: graphic

contentFit.register: The static-image container for any image that stands alone or pairs with a text component: diagrams, charts, photographs, illustrations the learner views but does not interact with; no stepped reveal, hotspot interaction, or slideshow behaviour (§1).
A purely decorative image paired with a text component that carries the meaning; set _isOptional: true so it doesn't block completion (§3 guardrail 6).

entries.accessibility: alt text is the primary accessibility feature and must convey the same information a sighted learner would gain; longdescription for complex diagrams renders below the image and is visible to all users (§6).
configNotes: Minimal schema: no _items, no _feedback, no interaction; the work is in the _graphic object and the alt text (§2)
small and large image versions are both required by the schema (§3 guardrail 4)
Completes on scroll-in by default; no 'must view' mechanic (§7)
No authored lesson instance exists yet; demo scaffold instances have blank alt text (Grounded in note)

entries.name: media

contentFit.register: The audio/video player for content the learner plays: explainer videos, recorded lectures, audio explanations, demonstrations; used when the medium genuinely adds value, not as a default (§1).

entries.accessibility: Captions are mandatory (_media.cc populated, _useClosedCaptions: true); transcript is strongly recommended (_transcript._inlineTranscript: true with full inlineTranscriptBody) (§6).
configNotes: Every video should have a transcript in addition to captions: essential for deaf learners, useful for all learners who skim or search (§3 guardrail 2)
Choose _setCompletionOn deliberately: play / ended / inview each carry different completion implications (§3 guardrail 4)
Avoid _preventForwardScrubbing unless genuinely required (§3 guardrail 5)
No authored lesson instance exists yet; c-135 is Adapt demo scaffold content, not a voice model (Grounded in note)

entries.name: slider

contentFit.register: A numeric-scale question: estimating a quantity, placing a value on a continuum, or selecting a rating, where the correct answer is a single value or an accepted range (§1).
Assessment context; formative/summative bundle set as a unit, same discipline as mcq (§3 guardrail 3).

entries.accessibility: ariaScaleName is required and describes what the scale measures for screen-reader users; the slider can be operated with arrow keys (§6).
configNotes: Set either _correctAnswer or _correctRange, not both; _correctAnswer (a string) takes precedence if populated (§3 guardrail 1)
_scaleStart and _scaleEnd must include the correct answer (§3 guardrail 4)
No _partlyCorrect branch: unlike mcq, the learner is either in the range or out (§7)
No authored lesson instance exists yet; c-230 is Adapt demo scaffold content, not a voice model (Grounded in note)

entries.name: hotspot

contentFit.register: Learner identifies one or more labelled regions on an authored image (a diagram, map, or structural view). Region text follows §15.4 instruction register; each region's accessible name is built from the areaLabel global template ('Area N of M: text').
Realises spot-the-error for image-based content: finding a fault in a document image (for example, a reference missing an element), rather than choosing among worded options as mcq/gmcq do.

entries.accessibility: Alt text and long description are both required on the authored image (properties.schema _graphic.longdescription: required:true), stricter than adapt-contrib-graphic where longdescription is optional; reading order is question -> alt text -> long description, both authored. Regions are native radio/checkbox inputs inside fieldset/legend (never a role=radiogroup div), each carrying its own accessible name; focus outline meets 3:1 contrast (@item-color-focus, traced); selection is shown by outline plus icon, never colour alone.
configNotes: 2-8 regions total (1 or more correct, 2-5 decoys); shape is fixed to 'rect', the only value properties.schema currently permits

Region validation (count, overlap, in-bounds) and geometry warnings (regions under 12% width or 8% height) are unit-tested in hotspotLogic.js but NOT wired into any build-time or runtime check yet — authoring currently relies on the author following the guardrails, not on automated enforcement (see hotspot.md §7)
List-mode fallback (plain stacked list, 44px minimum tap target) triggers automatically when any region would render under 44x44 CSS px, computed from the rendered image size, not a media query
_isRadio (single- vs multi-select) is computed at runtime by ItemsQuestionModel.init() from _selectable, never authored directly
Built on ItemsQuestionModel/QuestionView with zero overrides to attempts, marking, model-answer, or SCORM 'choice' interaction behaviour — same base as mcq/gmcq

entries.name: ab-hotgraphic

contentFit.register: Spatial overview with whole-shape-at-once visibility, VO-1 treatment 1 — same shape as hotgraphic, rebuilt on a live inlined SVG so the diagram's own hover/focus and the --ab-* theme cascade apply to it, rather than an opaque .
Interactive diagram with click/keyboard-activated regions resolved from the authored SVG (data-ab-hotspot / id / explicit selector), not fixed pin coordinates over a flat image.

configNotes: _diagram.src: the inlined SVG, a course asset; _items[]._hotspot: binds each item to a node in it ({_id|_selector}, plus _action: popup|inlineReveal|none)

A diagram's own class vocabulary (wedge/label/label-sub paint hooks, data-ab-hotspot regions) is the interface layer — a new diagram costs a theme-level token block (src/extensions/adapt-ab-theme/less/ab-hotgraphic.less), never new component code
No _isNarrativeOnMobile equivalent: narrow widths swap to the always-correct accessible <ol> list via a container query, never a second authored layout
First consumer: ULAF cycle diagram in W-OPEN signpost (ulaf-cycle.svg), replacing the stock hotgraphic instance there

entries.name: callout

contentFit.register: Short categorised aside (info/tip/warning/example/note/definition); mid-register, one point per callout. Register lives in body text, not config (FC-2).

configNotes: _type sets the category: info|warning|tip|example|note|definition
title + body only; keep body to 1-3 sentences; not a content block in its own right

entries.name: keyTerm

contentFit.register: A single key term with definition; glossary idiom, why-before-how in the definition, tier-appropriate depth.
Term visible, extended definition/examples disclosed on demand.

configNotes: term + definition required; pronunciation, extendedDefinition, example optional
one term per instance; for a set of terms use palette/glossary

entries.name: quoteBlock

contentFit.register: An attributed quotation; the quote carries the voice, context frames why it matters.

configNotes: quote + context (attribution/framing)
use for a single pulled quotation, not running prose

entries.name: statBlock

contentFit.register: 2-6 highlighted statistics; each a value with a short label; sources cited, not editorialised.

configNotes: title + 2-6 items (value/label/context/source)
for emphasis of figures, not a data table

entries.name: textTagging

contentFit.register: Interactive classification: learners tag spans of a passage with categories from a palette; the instruction text carries the task framing.
Learn-by-doing categorisation over a real passage.

configNotes: title + body (the passage) + instruction
learners select spans and assign a category from the configured palette
ported from pw02 / congen11 text-tagging; an activity, not a reveal

entries.name: gowTimeline

contentFit.register: 2-12 events in time order, ascending or descending; sequence idiom.
Ordered stages shown as a vertical track.

configNotes: title + 2-12 items (time/label/body)
_component is 'gowTimeline' (distinct from adapt-abbott-timeline whose _component is 'timeline')
track dots styled from the shared card idiom

entries.name: ab-card

contentFit.register: A set of 2-6 titled cards for parallel items; mid-register, one idea per card.

configNotes: instruction + _items[] (each card: title/body, optional image)
for a set of comparable items; a single emphasis uses palette/callout

entries.name: ab-carousel

contentFit.register: A swipeable sequence of slides; one idea per slide, order carries meaning.

configNotes: instruction + _items[] (slides)
for ordered or gallery content; for simultaneous comparison use palette/ab-card

entries.name: ab-callouts

contentFit.register: Several categorised asides grouped together.

configNotes: instruction + _items[] (each: _type/title/body)
for a cluster of asides; a single one uses palette/callout

entries.name: ab-hero

contentFit.register: A banner opener (eyebrow/heading/body) that sets the scene for a page or section.

configNotes: eyebrow + heading + body, optional background image
a page/section opener, not inline teaching content

entries.name: modal

contentFit.register: A trigger that opens secondary detail in an overlay; interactive reveal.
Summary visible, fuller detail revealed on demand in a modal.

configNotes: a trigger + modal body content
interactive: opens an overlay; keep modal content focused
adapt-abbott-modal (_component: modal)
